verdict.rationale: Sketch documents Libraries. Starred versions explicitly control which versions become Library updates for consumers, and community users corroborate symbols and libraries for design systems. The evidence does not show styles, as distinct from Symbols, being published through Libraries, nor sharing across separate projects or Workspaces. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that text/layer styles and color variables publish via Libraries, evidence of cross-project/cross-Workspace library distribution, and details of how consumers accept or decline updates.

support.subject: As a designer, shared libraries publish components and styles across files and projects, with controlled updates when the source changes

citations.quote: control which versions become Library updates for Editors
When you star a version in a Library document, anyone using that Library will receive a Library update.
starring a version will publish any changes as a Library update. Any unstarred versions after that won’t become Library updates.
create reusable components and Libraries, set up design systems
It shines when you embrace Sketch symbols and libraries, allowing DRY, component-based designs.
